meta.description: Maps muapi Studio 'Apps' tab tools to the closest public muapi API endpoint or template workflow.
checked: Studio page HTML and its 29 public JS chunks (no app names found; the app list is loaded elsewhere)
Keyword search of names and descriptions across all of the above
notChecked: The logged-in dashboard pages (Apps, Workflow, Agents, Integrations)
The requests the Studio makes when an app is opened or run
caveats: The Studio apps themselves are closed source and are not published as named API endpoints.
The app list is partial: it was transcribed from screenshots, and some cards (e.g. part of Ads & Products) were not visible.
endpoint-probable and workflow-similar are name/purpose based guesses, not confirmed identical behaviour.
